Subject: Inquiry: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency) + credits

Hannah —

Thanks again for the product demo last week. CloudBridge is preparing a procurement packet for our security team and we need a consolidated view of pricing for the following add-ons:

- Audit log retention (30d / 90d / 365d tiers)
- External KMS integration with HSM (per-seat + monthly management fee)
- Data residency in us-east-1 (application data + audit logs)
- HIPAA-specific handling (BAA + any extra fees)

A couple of specifics from our side: we expect ~1.2B tokens/month at peak, steady growth ~30% YoY, and are targeting a start-of-year deployment (Jan). Procurement also asked whether Redwood offers migration/onboarding credits for a 2-year committed contract.

Can you provide a consolidated SOW/pricing snapshot and call out one-time vs recurring line items? Procurement needs something by Friday (27th) to make the vendor shortlist.

Thanks,
Julie
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudBridge Technologies

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Inquiry: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency) + credits

Julie —

Appreciate the details and timeline. I pulled together a high-level summary below; I'm attaching a pricing worksheet (redwood-compliance-pricing-sheet.xlsx) and a draft SOW stub (CloudBridge-SOW-v3.pdf) for procurement.

Summary (ballpark monthly recurring charges):
- Audit log retention: $0.06/GB for 30d, $0.09/GB for 90d, $0.14/GB for 365d (storage + indexed query).
- KMS/HSM: one-time HSM provisioning slot $4,500, + $850/month per HSM seat (includes monitoring and key rotation automation).
- Data residency: regional egress/storage differential $0.03/token equivalent applied to storage/backup; routing fee depends on replica count.
- HIPAA: BAA available (no separate per-token premium); additional compliance admin and attestation support is billed as a professional services retainer (typical range $8k–$20k depending on scope).

On credits: for a 2-year committed spend (we'd need to see committed $ baseline), we can offer a one-time migration credit up to 6% of the first year committed ARR (applied to onboarding fees or first invoices). We can also tier in volume discounts (see attached sheet).

Next steps: can you confirm expected audit log volume (GB/month) and whether you want native KMS or Redwood-hosted key wrapping? That will change the HSM sizing. If procurement agrees, we can finalize the SOW and include the migration credit language.

I'll leave HSM sizing and exact discount math to Marcus and Priyom. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive — Compliance & Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-compliance-pricing-sheet.xlsx, CloudBridge-SOW-v3.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Inquiry: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency) + credits

Julie —

Quick technical clarifications that impact pricing:
- HSM sizing: given 1.2B tokens/month peak, if you opt for Redwood-hosted key wrapping with HSM-backed KEKs, we recommend starting with 3 HSM seats (hot keys + failover), which maps to the $4,500 provisioning + 3 x $850/mo. If CloudBridge brings its own KMS (BYOK), integration work is a one-time engineering onboarding fee (~$12k) and then no per-seat charge on our side.
- Audit logs: your ingested token volume suggests ~3–6 TB of audit logs/month depending on verbosity and retention window. The 365d retention bucket materially increases costs — we can show a delta in the sheet.
- Residency: keeping logs + backups in us-east-1 is straightforward; cross-region replication for DR will add an additional 15% on storage costs.

I'll flag that for procurement, the HSM seat model is often handled as a capital-like provisioning fee plus smaller monthly ops. If procurement prefers, we can amortize provisioning over the first year to reduce up-front hit.

—Marcus
Principal Applied Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
